settings.editor: Digi2U prepares adults for well-paid technology jobs and in-demand businesses through innovative, hands-on STEAM training — Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math — that excites, inspires, and delivers marketable skills.
Digi2U is dedicated to providing hands-on training in technology, media, and creative industries to empower individuals and communities. The national workforce picture below is why that work matters.

Digi2U prepares adults for well-paid technology jobs and in-demand businesses through hands-on STEAM training with real-life application. We collaborate with local organizations, schools, government, and businesses to expand access to technology and opportunity.

Hands-on experience on live productions and builds, applying classroom knowledge in a real-world setting.

Adult learners leave with marketable skills, finished products, and portfolios — real tools, real projects, real outcomes.

Digi2U is dedicated to providing hands-on training in technology, media, and creative industries to empower individuals and communities. Through innovative programs, we equip students with the skills, tools, and resources needed to succeed in the digital age — fostering growth, creativity, and career advancement.
To equip our communities with the tools, training, and opportunities to succeed.
A world where all individuals, regardless of background, have access to the resources needed to thrive in a technology-driven society.
We build with the communities we serve, not for them. Local voices shape every program.
To unlock well-paid tech jobs and in-demand businesses for adult learners, creatives, and entrepreneurs.
Empowering communities through collaboration. We work hand-in-hand with grassroots foundations, cultural organizations, and community institutions across Newark, Jersey City, and Atlanta.
